slices.name: New boards: Workable job search + Jobgether
slices.notes:
SLICE 24 - New boards (added 2026-11-11 IST): Workable's cross-company job search (jobs.workable.com JSON API, remote + India) and Jobgether 'Remote from India' role pages. Own Ember jobs call with `sources` below.
KNOWN PARSER LIMITS (do not treat as facts): rows come back with remote:'Onsite' or 'Unknown', empty company/location, and Jobgether puts the age ('7 days ago') in the location field. Ignore the remote/location fields from these sources; every listing page is already filtered to remote-India.
MANDATORY VERIFY: you MUST Ember-scrape every candidate that passes the title include/exclude words (cap 15 per run, newest first; Jobgether rows saying '30+ days ago' are stale -> skip without scraping). maxTokens 1500, render:true on 403. Company = text after '-at-' at the end of the Workable url, or from the page; Jobgether real company is on the offer page. Apply the hard rejects strictly: keep only Remote from India/Asia/Anywhere, min experience 0-2 yrs, posted within 14 days. A run that matched candidates but scraped none is NOT done: set status 'crashed' with detail 'skipped verify'. url saved = the Workable /view/ url or the Jobgether /offer/ url.

slices.name: SLICE 14
slices.notes:
SLICE 14 
Remote-first company sweep: check the ATS boards (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workable) of remote-first companies known to hire in India: GitLab, Automattic, Zapier, Doist, Toggl, Hotjar, Canonical, Wikimedia, Mozilla, Elastic, HashiCorp, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, Multiplier, Rippling, BrowserStack, Postman, Hevo, Atlan, Sprinto, Chargebee, Zeta, Razorpay, Freshworks, Zoho, Kpler, Vortexa, Arcesium, JLS Trading Co. (Swastik's favourite - remote-first, hires in India; check https://jlstradingco.applytojob.com/apply every run of this slice and add ANY non-warehouse, non-sales opening as a lead, flagging pay UNKNOWN if not stated), Coinbase, Stripe, Databricks, Atlassian, Google (APM India), Robinhood, Duolingo, FourKites, AppLovin, Fanatics, IXL Learning, Adobe (India product roles only). For these big names look for India-based or remote-India entry PM/APM/analyst roles; US-based new-grad programs fail unless visa sponsorship is stated. Filter titles for analyst/product/operations/implementation/business.
REMOTE-COMPANY LIST (added 2026-10-02, works without Firecrawl): slice 14 runs ALSO pull 25 companies per run from the GitHub list remoteintech/remote-jobs (Bash: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/remoteintech/remote-jobs.git ; company files in src/companies/*.md with frontmatter 'region' and 'website'). Use only region worldwide, asia-pacific or other; skip pure-engineering shops. Rotate through them alphabetically, tracking the last company used in slice_state/s14 'rij_last'. For each, open its careers page/ATS and screen non-sales, non-engineering roles under the normal rules.
